intro: South Sudanese culture is centred on cattle, songs and community.

chapters.title: Traditions
text: Cattle songs celebrate favourite animals. Scarification marks once showed which group a person belonged to.

chapters.title: Food
text: Kisra flatbread, asida porridge and stews are common.

keyTerms.meaning: A camp where herders live with their cattle.

items.title: Emmanuel Jal
items.subtitle: Musician
items.text: A former child soldier turned rapper.
